propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state that the close precheck requires a MERGED commit reachable from HEAD, when the implementation accepts any uncommitted local commit with a matching rebar-ticket trailer or ticket ID subject.
The close precheck is conditional on file_impact being recorded and the completion-verification gate being enabled, not unconditional as the documentation implies.

AGENTS.md never documents rebar transition --ref, which is the sanctioned way to close a stacked story against its own commit while the worktree remains at the epic tip, though it is documented in transition.txt and plan-review-gate.md.
The land-before-close ordering is enforced by the Verified +1 policy rule, not by the precheck mechanism, but the documentation misleadingly attributes it to the precheck.
The precheck accepts a referencing commit for the ticket OR any transitive descendant from the epics/stories/tasks/bugs buckets, not just the direct ticket.
